centralQuestion: To what extent can collective security justify restricting individual freedom and moral rights during a social crisis?
note: The text under 'From the source' is a paraphrase of the philosopher's argument. The application to your choices is this game's interpretation. It is not a verdict, no philosopher is claimed to endorse a particular option, and nothing here scores or ranks your choices.

hobbes.name: Thomas Hobbes
hobbes.question: Does the decision give the group the security that only a common power can provide, and what limit does it leave on that power?

locke.name: John Locke
locke.question: Does the decision protect life, liberty and property, and can those affected judge how power was used?

rousseau.name: Jean-Jacques Rousseau
rousseau.question: Does the decision serve the common good as the people themselves would will it, or only the sum of private fears?
